description:
At Coram AI, we’re reimagining video security for the modern world. Our cloud-native platform uses computer vision and AI to help businesses stay safe, make smarter decisions, and move faster; from real-time alerts to seamless clip sharing and multi-site visibility.



You’ll be joining an ambitious, fast-moving team that values clarity, craftsmanship, and impact. Every person here has a voice, ships meaningful work, and helps shape how AI can make the world safer and more connected.




THE ROLE:

Coram is hiring its first in-house electrical engineer, at mid to senior level, to own board design for the hardware products we ship next. Coram is a Series B company using AI to make the world a safer place.



Our DC41, DC11 and door controllers are already shipping and in customers' hands. Until now the electrical work has been done by a contractor. You will bring that work in-house and take it forward across a roadmap that includes edge cameras, intercom devices and custom readers.



This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will sit in the hardware team and work closely with our mechanical engineers, taking boards from schematic to mass production.



RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Schematics: design the circuits for each product.

 - Board layout: lay out the PCBs.

 - Fabrication and assembly (PCBA): get boards built by manufacturers, at volume.

 - Manufacturer relationships: work directly with the factories and JDMs that build our boards, and keep those relationships healthy.

 - New product lines: build the electrical side of new products from scratch, including edge cameras, intercom devices and custom readers, working with cutting edge SoCs from Ambarella, Qualcomm, and NXP.

 - Existing products: support the boards already in the field as they move through production.

 - Cross-team work: partner with the mechanical engineers so boards and enclosures come together as one product.




QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Experience: 3+ years as an electrical, hardware or board design engineer.

 - Shipped at volume: you have taken boards all the way to mass production, not only prototypes.

 - End-to-end board ownership: schematics, layout and fabrication, rather than one piece of the process.

 - Manufacturers and JDMs: you have worked directly with contract manufacturers or JDMs.

 - New product launches: you have been part of a 0 to 1 product launch, ideally at a startup.

 - Board-level focus: your core work is board-level hardware. This is not a firmware, embedded software or chip-level (IC/ASIC) design role, although experience there is a plus




NICE-TO-HAVES:

 - Large-volume consumer electronics experience.

 - More than one new product launch behind you.

 - Experience owning a manufacturer relationship yourself, not only working within one.




WHAT WE OFFER:

 - Competitive compensation package (base salary + variable compensation)

 - 100% Employer-paid medical, dental, vision, and base life insurance

 - Flexible paid time off and 9 paid holidays

 - 401(k) with both Traditional and Roth options

 - Equity in a rapidly growing company

 - Referral bonuses

 - Daily team dinners and regular team off-sites to build connection and momentum

 - The latest Apple tech and unlimited tools so you can win



We're on a mission to transform a $50B+ legacy industry by bringing the power of cutting-edge multimodal LLMs and computer vision to real-world security and operations. From firearm detection to intelligent access control, our AI-native platform turns every camera and sensor into a smart system that enhances safety, efficiency, and awareness. 



Founded by Ashesh Jain (ex-Lyft Level 5, PhD Cornell) and Peter Ondruska (ex-Lyft, PhD Oxford), Coram AI is backed by Ansa Capital, Battery Ventures, Mosaic, 8VC and Up Partners, have raised over $65M, and were named to the CB Insights AI 100 as one of the most promising AI companies in the world. If you're excited to work on mission-critical AI that makes an impact in the real world, we’d love to meet you.
